post.title: Wispr Flow bills $15 a month. Whisper Free doesn't.
post.caption: One fresh grudge: $15 a month to turn your voice into text, replaced by someone annoyed enough to build the free, fully local version.

segments.quote: Wispr Flow is a great product, but it's a paid cloud service.

cues.say: Whisper Flow wants fifteen dollars a month
[sarcastic] Whisper Flow is a great product,

cues.cap: but it's a paid cloud service.”
So: Whisper Free. Runs on your machine.
